title: Sales and demand: hospital forecast vs consumption
description: How well hospital demand was forecast, and where it went unmet.

list.name: disease_category
list.label: Disease category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT disease_category FROM mart.dim_medicine WHERE is_current AND medicine_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT disease_category FROM mart.dim_medicine WHERE is_current AND medicine_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1

list.name: hospital
list.label: Hospital
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT hospital_name FROM mart.dim_hospital WHERE is_current AND hospital_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT hospital_name FROM mart.dim_hospital WHERE is_current AND hospital_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Consumption vs forecast
panels.description: (Packs consumed - packs forecast) / packs forecast x 100, from summed packs. Positive means hospitals consumed more than forecast.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * (sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs))
                       / NULLIF(sum(f.forecast_demand_packs), 0), 2) FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)

panels.title: Forecast error (WAPE)
panels.description: Weighted absolute percentage error: sum of |consumed - forecast| at hospital, medicine and month level / sum consumed x 100. Lower is better; over- and under-forecasts do not cancel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(abs(f.consumed_quantity_packs - f.forecast_demand_packs))
                       / NULLIF(sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs), 0), 2) FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)

panels.title: Request fill rate
panels.description: Packs received / packs requested x 100 (ratio of sums).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(f.received_quantity_packs)
                       / NULLIF(sum(f.requested_quantity_packs), 0), 2) FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)

panels.title: Dispensing service level
panels.description: Share of demand that could be dispensed: 1 - unfulfilled / (dispensed + unfulfilled). This is what the source's ServiceLevelPct measures; it differs from the request fill rate beside it (decision 14).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * (1 - sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs)::numeric
                       / NULLIF(sum(f.dispensed_quantity_packs) + sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs), 0)), 2)
                 FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)

panels.title: Unfulfilled demand
panels.description: Packs of demand that could not be met (source value).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs), 0) FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)

panels.title: Stockout days
panels.description: Days with a stockout, summed over hospital, medicine and month records.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(f.stockout_days), 0) FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)

panels.title: Forecast vs consumption (packs per month)
panels.description: Hospital forecast demand (gray) against what was actually consumed (blue), same unit and axis. Filters above apply to every panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.full_date::timestamp AS time, sum(f.forecast_demand_packs) AS "Forecast",
                          sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) AS "Consumed" FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)
                   GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Consumption vs forecast by disease category (%)
panels.description: Variance from summed packs per disease category. Positive = consumed more than forecast. The zero line is the forecast.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.disease_category AS "disease category",
                        round(100.0 * (sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs))
                              / NULLIF(sum(f.forecast_demand_packs), 0), 2) AS "Variance (%)"
                 FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Largest forecast gaps by medicine
panels.description: The ten medicines whose total consumption is furthest from forecast, in packs. WAPE shows month-by-month error even where over- and under-forecasts cancel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.generic_name AS medicine,
                         sum(f.forecast_demand_packs) AS forecast, sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) AS consumed,
                         sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs) AS "variance (packs)",
                         round(100.0 * (sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs))
                               / NULLIF(sum(f.forecast_demand_packs), 0), 2) AS "variance (%)",
                         round(100.0 * sum(abs(f.consumed_quantity_packs - f.forecast_demand_packs))
                               / NULLIF(sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs), 0), 2) AS "WAPE (%)"
                  FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1
                  ORDER BY abs(sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs)) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Unfulfilled demand by month (packs)
panels.description: Demand that could not be met, per month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.full_date::timestamp AS time, sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) AS "Unfulfilled packs"
                   FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Unfulfilled demand: hospital and medicine pairs
panels.description: The ten hospital and medicine combinations with the most unmet demand.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.hospital_name || ' - ' || m.generic_name AS pair,
                        sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) AS "Unfulfilled packs"
                 FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY h.hospital_name, m.generic_name
                 HAVING sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Unfulfilled demand detail
panels.description: Where demand went unmet: how much, the request fill rate and how often stock ran out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.hospital_name AS hospital, m.generic_name AS medicine,
                         sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) AS unfulfilled,
                         round(100.0 * sum(f.received_quantity_packs)
                               / NULLIF(sum(f.requested_quantity_packs), 0), 2) AS "fill rate %",
                         sum(f.stockout_days) AS "stockout days"
                  FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) > 0
                  ORDER BY 3 DESC, 5 DESC LIMIT 15

defaults.noValue: No unfulfilled demand in this selection

panels.title: Stockout days by hospital
panels.description: Days with a stockout, by hospital, summed over medicines and months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.hospital_name AS hospital, sum(f.stockout_days) AS "Stockout days"
                 FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Request fill rate by month (%)
panels.description: Packs received / packs requested, by month. The axis does not start at zero: it shows small movements around a high rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.full_date::timestamp AS time,
                          round(100.0 * sum(f.received_quantity_packs)
                                / NULLIF(sum(f.requested_quantity_packs), 0), 2) AS "Fill rate (%)"
                   FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
